description: Needs an API key. Returns a Stripe Checkout link for a monthly or annual credit plan, for the person to open and pay; nothing is charged until they do. Credits are added each month while the plan lasts. Plans: plan_100_monthly ($17.50 a month, 100 credits a month); plan_100_annual ($168 a year, 100 credits a month); plan_1k_monthly ($140 a month, 1,000 credits a month); plan_1k_annual ($1,344 a year, 1,000 credits a month); plan_10k_monthly ($1,050 a month, 10,000 credits a month); plan_10k_annual ($10,080 a year, 10,000 credits a month); plan_25k_monthly ($1,750 a month, 25,000 credits a month); plan_25k_annual ($16,800 a year, 25,000 credits a month); plan_50k_monthly ($2,625 a month, 50,000 credits a month); plan_50k_annual ($25,200 a year, 50,000 credits a month); plan_100k_monthly ($3,500 a month, 100,000 credits a month); plan_100k_annual ($33,600 a year, 100,000 credits a month). If the account already has a plan, it is not changed: the person manages it at https://svgmill.com/account/. Prices: https://svgmill.com/pricing/.
